author: shoop_raton
body:
Hello, my minecraft IGN is Thyphis, and I was banned fro evasion from one of my friend's accounts. I wish to be unbanned because this was done against my will. My account password is saved to his computer, so I'm guessing he logged on to my account and banned me purposely. The reason I think it is false is because 1. My password should have never been saved to his computer in the first place. And 2. , i had no willpower to stop him from getting me banned, there's something he dislikes about this server, and I guess he hates when i play on it, so banned me purposely. The only evidence I can show to staff is that it wasn't me. I'm not the person to go around and ban myslef from any server. I haven't been caught "ban evading" before, and I wont ever, like I said, this wasn't me. The person who did this was DogeNetic, aka ZazooZa, or ZaTheGreat. He has been banned on both accounts.

Thanks for reading,
Thyphis

title: Ban Appeal

replies.author: hpux
replies.body:
Hello Thyphis,

After researching, I have discovered that DogeNetic is, in fact, not your account. Therefore, your appeal has been accepted. Sorry for the inconvenience.

Regards,
Dutchis
Avicus Network Administrator.
